entries.title: Successful logon
entries.what: An account logged on. Logon type tells how: 2 = at the keyboard, 3 = network share, 5 = service, 7 = unlock, 10 = Remote Desktop.
fix: Unexpected type 10 (RDP) logons from unknown addresses should be investigated

entries.title: Failed logon
entries.what: A logon attempt failed. The message shows the account, the reason and the source address.
causes: Mistyped or old password (phone, mapped drive, service, scheduled task)
Password-guessing attack (many failures, often from one IP, often over RDP or SMB)
fix: Many failures from one address = brute force: block the address, do not expose RDP to the internet
Repeated failures for one user from one PC: update the stored password on that PC/service

entries.title: Logoff
entries.what: A logon session ended. Very frequent and normal.

entries.title: User initiated logoff
entries.what: A user signed out.

entries.title: Logon with explicit credentials
entries.what: A process logged on using credentials typed explicitly (RunAs, mapped drive with other user, scheduled task).
fix: Investigate if you see it for admin accounts from unexpected processes

entries.title: Special privileges assigned to logon
entries.what: An administrator-level logon received sensitive privileges. Logged at every admin or SYSTEM logon.

entries.title: Process created
entries.what: A new process started (if process auditing is enabled).

entries.title: Process exited
entries.what: A process ended (if process auditing is enabled).

entries.title: Service installed
entries.what: A new service was installed. Normal for installs - also a common malware persistence method.
fix: Verify the service name and path

entries.title: Scheduled task created
entries.what: A scheduled task was created. Normal for software - also used by malware for persistence.
fix: Verify the task name and the command it runs

entries.title: Scheduled task deleted
entries.what: A scheduled task was deleted.

entries.title: Scheduled task enabled/disabled/updated
entries.what: A scheduled task was enabled, disabled or changed.

entries.title: System time changed
entries.what: The system time was changed. Normal for time sync; manual changes can be used to confuse logs.

entries.title: Audit policy changed
entries.what: The system audit policy was changed. Disabling auditing can hide malicious activity.

entries.title: User account created
entries.what: A new user account was created.

entries.title: User account enabled
entries.what: A user account was enabled.

entries.title: User changed their password
entries.what: An attempt was made to change an account's password.

entries.title: Password reset by administrator
entries.what: An administrator reset an account's password.

entries.title: User account disabled
entries.what: A user account was disabled.

entries.title: User account deleted
entries.what: A user account was deleted.

entries.title: User account changed
entries.what: Properties of a user account were changed.

entries.title: Account locked out
entries.what: An account was locked after too many failed logons. The caller computer is where the bad attempts came from.
causes: Old password saved on a phone, mapped drive, service or scheduled task on the caller computer
fix: Go to the caller computer and update/remove stored credentials (Credential Manager, mail on phones, services)
Unlock the account after fixing the source

entries.title: Account unlocked
entries.what: A locked account was unlocked.

entries.title: Member added to a security group
entries.what: An account was added to a security group. Additions to Administrators / Domain Admins deserve a look.

entries.title: Member removed from a security group
entries.what: An account was removed from a security group.

entries.title: Local group membership enumerated (user)
entries.what: A process listed a user's local group membership. Very common and harmless.

entries.title: Local group membership enumerated
entries.what: A process listed members of a local group. Very common and harmless.

entries.title: Kerberos ticket (TGT) requested
entries.what: A domain controller issued (or refused) a Kerberos ticket-granting ticket.

entries.title: Kerberos service ticket requested
entries.what: A domain controller issued a service ticket.

entries.title: Kerberos pre-authentication failed
entries.what: On a domain controller: a Kerberos logon failed, usually a wrong password (code 0x18).
fix: Check the client address in the message for stored old credentials

entries.title: NTLM credential validation
entries.what: The computer/DC validated credentials using NTLM. Error code 0xC000006A = wrong password.

entries.title: Session reconnected
entries.what: A user reconnected to a Windows session (often Remote Desktop).

entries.title: Session disconnected
entries.what: A user disconnected from a Windows session.

entries.title: Workstation locked
entries.what: The workstation was locked.

entries.title: Workstation unlocked
entries.what: The workstation was unlocked.

entries.title: Network share accessed
entries.what: A network share was accessed.

entries.title: Network share object checked
entries.what: Access to a file on a share was checked (detailed file share auditing). Very frequent.

entries.title: Object access attempt
entries.what: A file, folder or registry key with auditing enabled was accessed.

entries.title: Handle to an object requested
entries.what: A process requested access to an audited object.

entries.title: Permissions on an object changed
entries.what: Permissions (ACL) of a file, folder or other object were changed.

entries.title: Registry value modified
entries.what: An audited registry value was changed.

entries.title: Firewall allowed a connection
entries.what: Windows Filtering Platform allowed a connection. Extremely frequent when enabled.

entries.title: Firewall blocked a connection
entries.what: Windows Filtering Platform blocked a connection.

entries.title: Firewall permitted a bind
entries.what: A program was allowed to listen on a local port. Very frequent.

entries.title: Firewall rule added/changed/deleted
entries.what: A Windows Firewall rule was added, modified or deleted.
fix: Unexpected rules that open ports should be reviewed

entries.title: Firewall setting changed
entries.what: A Windows Firewall setting was changed.

entries.title: Credential Manager credentials read
entries.what: A process read saved credentials from Credential Manager. Very common and normal.

entries.title: New external device recognized
entries.what: A new device (e.g. USB drive) was recognized by the system.

entries.title: Boot configuration data loaded
entries.what: Recorded at every boot. Harmless.

entries.title: Windows is starting up
entries.what: Recorded by the security subsystem at every boot.

entries.title: Auditing settings on object changed
entries.what: Auditing settings of an object changed - very often Windows Update/servicing touching system files. Usually harmless.

entries.title: Key migration operation
entries.what: A cryptographic key was migrated. Routine and harmless.

entries.title: Cryptographic operation / key file operation
entries.what: A cryptographic key was used or accessed. Routine and harmless.

entries.title: Special group logged on
entries.what: A member of a group configured as 'special' logged on.
